card.name: Periods ending a sentence or reference
card.fires_on: A period that closes a sentence, often right before a new sentence, bullet or closing parenthesis. It also fires on the second or third dot of an ellipsis, and on periods after a cross-reference such as (See PRECAUTIONS, General.).

modes.label: Period after cross-reference
modes.description: The period sits at the end of a see-section pointer, often just before a closing parenthesis.
modes.example: (See PRECAUTIONS, General<< .>>) Directions for Drug Preparation Procedural

modes.label: Sentence-final period before bullet or new sentence
modes.description: A period ends an instruction or statement, and a bullet or new sentence follows.
modes.example: Do not break open, crush, dissolve, or chew omega-3-acid ethyl esters capsules.<< .>> • The daily dose of omega-3

modes.label: Ellipsis dots
modes.description: A later dot in a run of periods that marks trailing off or omitted text.
modes.example: Do you see yourself .<< .>> . • working with a team of researchers

card.plain: It marks the end of a sentence or the dots of an ellipsis, just before the next piece of text starts.
